families.invariant: No EXECUTED/VERIFIED/FIDELITY authority may derive from chat state alone. Require resolvable head + provider run + artifact/evidence provenance.
Every fidelity gate over frame series must preserve at least minimum/worst-frame and low-percentile evidence in addition to the mean. Mean success cannot erase a material local residual.
A target entity must have semantically isolated measurement identity before connected-component geometry is used for fidelity authority.
Continuous source-visible motion may not be replaced by one stable bbox or coarse semantic anchor without equivalence proof.
A reduced/keyframe projection may replace a full-frame measured track only if an automated equivalence test proves declared error bounds.
The oracle must compare the same authority type: layout proxy to layout proxy, visible glyph outline to visible glyph outline, asset morphology to asset morphology.
Renderer interpolation domains must satisfy runtime monotonicity independently of physical direction; mapping equivalence must be regression-tested.
Canonical source audio-event timing and renderer scheduling compensation are separate nodes. Calibration may move the renderer event but may never rewrite source timing.
Entity identity across crossings must use temporal continuity/semantic evidence. Corrections are versioned and preserve original raw measurements.
Tests protect contracts/state/behavior, not arbitrary prose strings. Documentation cannot become runtime authority through brittle assertions.
Action revisions require provider-resolvable provenance. Never repair an immutable SHA by visually guessing missing characters; shape validation alone is insufficient.
Dynamic Python test modules using dataclass/type resolution must be registered in sys.modules before exec_module. Harness failures cannot be attributed to product code.
